historical_record.description: Michelangelo Park, built with Open Space funds and almost $100,000 raised by the community, with a play area, community garden, meadow, half basketball court and small stage, was to be dedicated on June 3, 1990.

The Board of Education turned over its school lot on Greenwich Street between Jones and Leavenworth Streets, 137 feet square; the Playground Commission rehabilitated the decayed temporary school building as a community center and leveled, paved and lit the lot, all for under $25,000.
